text:
Anna: Quick ask — need a 1-page launch quicknote for enterprise buyers covering security, SLA tiers, and deploy-mode routing. Short, prescriptive, and a lead-gen handoff callout. Target: field + webinar follow-ups. Can someone take draft?
Drew: I can draft outline. Aim for 1 pager + one-sentence shareable intro for emails. Keep technical bits to bullets.
Maria: I'll add inbound routing snippet for SDRs — what fields do you want in handoff? (region, tier, POC?)
Anna: Good Q — include: customer segment, deployment preference (hosted/dedicated/private), security needs (SOC2, KMS, on-prem), SLA tier, immediate next step (contact link + intake form).
Jamal: For routing, suggest fields: ARR band, compliance req (HIPAA/Gov), preferred region, security contact, urgency flag. We'll map to sales queues.
Drew: Outline draft: 1) Headline value prop 2) Deployment modes matrix 3) Security assurances 4) SLA options + costs 5) How to engage (webinar, demo, dedicated trial) 6) Quick FAQ.
Anna: Perfect. Can you keep the matrix visual friendly — 3 rows (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) x 4 cols (isolation, SLA, cost signal, time to deploy).
Drew: Yep. I'll attach a plaintext version here by EOD.
Maria: For SDR handoff copy: one short para + routing tags. I'll draft and post tomorrow morning.
Jamal: Also propose two inbound email snippets: one for compliance-sensitive buyers, one for cost-performance buyers. Short, < 60 words.
Anna: Webinar tie-in: we'll add a tiny banner CTA on slide deck linking to intake form and a standard follow-up email template. Marketing to own slide banner + assets.
Drew: Quick note on metrics: capture MQL source, deployment preference, SLA interest, and demo booked. Those fields should populate SFDC lead.
Maria: +1. I'll update the playbook doc with field mappings and sample Jira label.
Anna: Thanks team. Publish a first draft in #marketing by tomorrow noon, tag me. :thumbsup:
